situation: Our CRM implementation partner hasn't updated ticket #CR-3391 since Sept 19; we opened it on Sept 17 when lead routing broke after their last deploy. About 40 inbound leads a day land unassigned and we've sent error logs and a screen recording twice. I want to go to their account manager, Priya, directly.
reply: Hi Priya, ticket #CR-3391 has been open since 17 September with no update since the 19th. Lead routing broke after the last deploy and about 40 inbound leads a day are landing unassigned, so our reps are missing first contact. We've sent the error logs and a screen recording twice. Can you get a consultant assigned by end of day Thursday and confirm here? If that's not possible, I need to know now so we can route leads manually.
note: Facts with dates, impact in numbers, what you've tried, one ask with a deadline.

situation: 我们项目依赖另一个组的订单接口，对接的同事小刘一直说'快了快了'，已经拖了两周，下周五就要上线。我知道他手上排了好几件事。我打算找他们组长张组长，但想先跟小刘打个招呼。
reply: 刘哥，先跟你说一声，免得你从别人那里听到：订单接口的事我今天会跟张组长提一下，主要是下周五就要上线了，时间实在压不住。不是针对你，我知道你手上排了好几件事。后面沟通我都会抄送你。
note: 越级之前先打招呼，说清是时间问题不是人的问题，这是升级和背刺的区别。

situation: I emailed my manager Tom twice (Sept 12 and 19) that our biggest client Delmar ($310k a year) wants a 6% discount to sign a three-year renewal, and the contract expires Oct 1. Legal needs a day for the paperwork. He hasn't replied, he's swamped with the merger. Going to his boss Anita now.
reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Wed 30 Sept: Delmar renewal pricing
Hi Anita, I raised the Delmar renewal with Tom on the 12th and 19th, and I know the merger has him stretched. Delmar's contract ($310k a year) expires 1 October and they've asked for a 6% discount to sign a three-year term. I need a yes or no on the 6% by Wednesday 30 September so legal can turn the paperwork before it expires. My recommendation: approve it, since three years locks in our biggest account. Tom is copied.
note: Say you tried the manager first, copy him, keep it under 150 words, and close with your recommendation.

situation: Mein Internet ist seit dem 10. September komplett weg, ich arbeite im Homeoffice (Kundennummer 4471 2290). Zwei Störungsmeldungen (Tickets 88120 und 88341), der Technikertermin am 22. ist ohne Nachricht ausgefallen. Ich will jetzt eine Beschwerde, die wirklich weitergeleitet wird, und wenn nichts passiert, gehe ich zur Schlichtungsstelle der Bundesnetzagentur. Ich heiße Sabine Krause.
reply:
Betreff: Dritte Meldung, Anschluss seit 10. September ausgefallen, Kundennummer 4471 2290
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
dies ist meine dritte Meldung zum Ausfall meines Internetanschlusses seit dem 10. September. Bisherige Ticketnummern: 88120 und 88341. Der Technikertermin am 22. September wurde ohne Nachricht nicht wahrgenommen. Ich arbeite von zu Hause und bin seit drei Wochen auf mobile Daten angewiesen. Bitte leiten Sie den Fall an Ihr Beschwerdemanagement weiter und bestätigen Sie mir bis Freitag, 2. Oktober, einen verbindlichen Technikertermin. Andernfalls wende ich mich an die Schlichtungsstelle der Bundesnetzagentur.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Sabine Krause
note: Ticketnummern und Daten statt Adjektive, eine Bitte mit Frist, und nur einen nächsten Schritt ankündigen, den man auch wirklich geht.

situation: I escalated to my director Paul that our Quantix data contract lapses Oct 15 and legal needs to review the renewal, which takes them two days. He replied 'not a priority this week, Q4 planning first.' If it lapses, the trading desk loses its daily pricing feed.
reply: Understood, Q4 planning comes first this week. So I can plan: if legal hasn't reviewed the Quantix renewal by Tuesday 13 October, the contract lapses on the 15th and the trading desk loses its daily pricing feed. Can you confirm in writing that we're accepting that risk, or tell me who else can approve legal's time? I want to make sure it's a decision and not a default.
note: When they say it isn't a priority, don't argue: restate the dated consequence and ask for the risk to be accepted in writing, or for another decision-maker.

situation: I run a small agency rebuilding a client's website. Their marketing lead, Josh, owes us the product copy and photos for 40 pages, due Sept 8, and launch is Nov 2. We've spoken three times since and he keeps saying 'this week'. I told Josh yesterday I'd raise the timeline with their COO, Linda. Now the email to her.
reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Fri 2 Oct: website launch date

Hi Linda, the 2 November launch is at risk. We still need the product copy and photos for 40 pages, originally due 8 September. Josh and I have spoken three times since, and he knows I'm raising the timeline with you. Two options: launch on the 2nd with the 15 core pages and add the rest by 20 November, or move launch to Monday 16 November. I recommend the phased launch, and we'd need the core page content by Friday 9 October. Could you let me know which by this Friday?
note: Escalating to a client's sponsor is about the date, not Josh: say he knows, give two options and a recommendation.

situation: 我是一家电商公司的运维。我们用的云服务商从9月27日起生产环境间歇性报502，大概3%的请求失败，用户在结账页面直接报错。工单CS-20931开了三天，一线只让我们清缓存、重启实例，两样都做过了，我们有能复现问题的curl命令。想直接要求升级到二线技术支持。
reply: 您好，工单CS-20931申请升级到二线技术支持。问题：9月27日起，我们的生产环境间歇性返回502，约3%的请求失败，可用下方的curl命令复现。影响：用户在结账页面直接报错，影响成交。已尝试：按一线建议清过缓存、重启过实例，问题依旧。请今天内指派一位负责工程师，并告知首次响应的预计时间。
note: 技术类升级：现象、比例、复现方式、影响和已试过的步骤写清，只要一个负责人和一个响应时间，不评价一线客服。

situation: I sent my teammate Marcus a heads-up, then escalated our stuck data migration to our manager Helen because the client cutover is Oct 16. Helen reassigned part of it. Now Marcus messaged me: 'Could've just talked to me instead of going to Helen.'
reply: I hear that it landed badly, and I'm sorry it felt like going around you. I sent you the note first because I didn't want you blindsided, but I can see a message isn't the same as a conversation. The date was what worried me, not your work. I'd rather sort things out with you than around you. Can we grab ten minutes today at 3?
note: When the person you went past is upset, don't defend the escalation; acknowledge it, restate that it was about the date, and ask to talk.

situation: On Sept 22 I escalated to Hannah, the regional manager at our letting agency, because the boiler at our flat (Flat 3, 14 Carlow Road) has been out since Sept 14 and the maintenance line kept saying 'booked in'. I asked for a repair date by Friday. Nothing back. I have a two-year-old and it's getting cold at night. If this goes nowhere I'll contact the council's private housing team.
reply: Hi Hannah, following up on my email of 22 September: the Friday deadline has passed and I haven't had a reply. The boiler at Flat 3, 14 Carlow Road has now been out for more than two weeks, and the nights are getting cold with a two-year-old in the flat. Are you the right person to book the repair, or should I take it to someone else? Either answer helps. If I don't have a repair date by Thursday 1 October, I'll contact the council's private housing team.
note: An ignored escalation: reply on the same thread, restate the facts and the one ask, and only name a next step you'll actually take.

situation: Two weeks ago I escalated our invoice rounding bug to my director Aisha, after sending a heads-up to Kenji on the platform team, who owned it and had already traced it to the currency conversion before I escalated. It sat in his queue behind other work. Aisha got it prioritised, Kenji's fix shipped yesterday, and she's confirmed the October billing run on Monday the 5th is clear. I want to close the loop with him.
reply: Kenji, update: the rounding fix went out yesterday, and Aisha has confirmed the October billing run on Monday the 5th is clear. I've told her the diagnosis was yours; you'd found the currency conversion bug before it ever reached her. Thanks for sticking with it while it sat in your queue.
note: Closing the loop with the person you went past: the outcome, and the credit where the work was done, so the escalation doesn't read as a takeover.

situation: Trabajo en el turno de mañana de un almacén en Getafe (soy Andrés Molina). La carretilla elevadora número 3 tiene el freno de mano fallando desde el 15 de septiembre: en la rampa del muelle 2 se desplaza con carga. Se lo dije al jefe de turno, Raúl, el 15 y el 22, mantenimiento no la ha revisado y la siguen usando; la carretilla 5 está libre por las tardes. Ya le he avisado a Raúl de que escribo a la jefa de planta, Elena.
reply:
Asunto: Decisión necesaria hoy: carretilla 3 con el freno de mano averiado
Hola, Elena: la carretilla elevadora número 3 tiene el freno de mano fallando desde el 15 de septiembre; en la rampa del muelle 2 se desplaza con carga. Se lo comuniqué a Raúl el 15 y el 22, mantenimiento aún no la ha revisado y se sigue usando en todos los turnos. Raúl sabe que te escribo. Te pido que la retires del servicio hoy hasta que mantenimiento confirme que es segura. Mi recomendación: etiquetarla como fuera de servicio y cubrir su trabajo con la carretilla 5, que está libre por las tardes.
Gracias,
Andrés Molina, turno de mañana
note: Con un riesgo de seguridad el plazo es hoy: hechos con fechas, lo ya intentado y una sola petición. Si no hay respuesta, el siguiente paso es el delegado de prevención.

situation: Freelance illustrator, Jo Park. Invoice #1042 for $3,800 to Harlow Books, for the spring list cover illustrations, was due Aug 28 under the 30-day terms in our contract. I emailed their accounts payable on Sept 1, 10 and 21 with no reply, and my art director Megan Doyle says she chased finance on Sept 15. I've told Megan I'm writing to their head of finance, Paul Grant, today.
reply:
Subject: Payment date needed by Fri 9 Oct: invoice #1042
Hi Paul, invoice #1042 for $3,800 (cover illustrations for the spring list) was due on 28 August under the 30-day terms in our contract. I emailed accounts payable on 1, 10 and 21 September with no reply, and Megan Doyle kindly chased internally on 15 September. It is now 32 days overdue. Could you confirm a payment date, or tell me who can, by Friday 9 October? The simplest fix is a bank transfer to the details on the attached invoice. Megan is copied. Thanks, Jo Park
note: Money owed by a client: facts and dates only, one ask with a deadline, and the heads-up to your friendly contact goes first.

situation: 我是7号楼1502的周晴。我们小区7号楼唯一的电梯9月20日坏了，到现在还没修。楼里有三户八十多岁的老人，其中1103的张阿姨每周要去医院透析两次，现在只能靠家人背下楼。物业前台两次都说“在等配件”。我想代表五户邻居写给物业经理李经理，让事情真正动起来。
reply: 李经理您好，我是7号楼1502的住户周晴，代表楼里五户邻居写这条消息。7号楼唯一的电梯从9月20日停到今天，前台两次答复都是“等配件”，没有维修日期。楼里有三位八十多岁的老人，其中1103的张阿姨每周要去医院透析两次，现在只能靠家人背下楼。麻烦您在10月2日前告诉我们：配件预计哪天到、哪天能修好，以及修好之前能否安排人手协助老人上下楼。谢谢您。
note: 代表多户升级时，写清你代表谁、影响最大的具体的人和一个带日期的问题；再没回应，下一步可以联系业委会或街道。

situation: I'm Maya Singh (student ID 20241187). My spring grade for STAT 301 still shows 'incomplete' though I submitted the final project through the course portal on May 10, and I have the receipt. My scholarship renewal needs a complete transcript by Friday Oct 16. I emailed the TA, Ben Carter, on Sept 8 and 21 and Professor Ortiz on Sept 24, no replies. I've told Professor Ortiz I'm writing to the undergraduate director, Dr. Lang.
reply:
Subject: Grade needed by Fri 9 Oct: STAT 301 incomplete, scholarship deadline
Dear Dr. Lang, my spring grade for STAT 301 (Professor Ortiz) still shows as incomplete, although I submitted the final project through the course portal on 10 May (receipt attached). My scholarship renewal needs a complete transcript by Friday 16 October. I emailed the TA, Ben Carter, on 8 and 21 September and Professor Ortiz on 24 September, and haven't had a reply; Professor Ortiz knows I'm writing to you and is copied. Could you help get the grade entered, or tell me who can, by Friday 9 October, so the registrar has a week to update the transcript? Thank you, Maya Singh, student ID 20241187
note: Academic escalation: the ask date sits a week before the real deadline, and the professor gets the heads-up and a copy, so it reads as a timeline problem, not a complaint.

situation: 我是陈静，儿子陈小宇上三（2）班。9月14日和9月23日两次跟班主任赵老师反映他在课间被同班一个男生推倒，第二次膝盖擦破了。赵老师说会处理，但儿子说这周还在发生，现在不太想去学校了。国庆假期后10月9日开学。我已经跟赵老师说了要找年级组长孙老师，现在要给孙老师发消息。
reply: 孙老师您好，我是三（2）班陈小宇的家长陈静。想请您帮忙跟进一件事：9月14日和9月23日，我两次向赵老师反映小宇课间被同班一位同学推倒，第二次膝盖擦破了；赵老师很重视，说会处理，但小宇这周说还在发生。我担心的是他的安全，现在他已经不太想去学校了。能否在10月9日开学后一周内，约我和赵老师一起见面谈一次，定下课间怎么看护？我已经跟赵老师说过会联系您，这不是对她的意见，只是希望多一个人帮忙把这件事落实。
note: 涉及孩子安全，照样先跟班主任打招呼、只写事实和日期；如果有受伤或持续发生，保留照片和记录。

situation: 我是运营部的，9月份加了22小时的班，都在考勤系统里审批过了，我有审批截图，但9月工资条上加班费是0。9月25号跟直属领导周经理说了，他让我找人事；9月28号我发邮件给人事专员小何，到现在没回。我已经跟小何说了会去找人事经理吴经理。
reply: 吴经理您好，我是运营部的林晓，想请您帮忙处理一笔工资的问题。我9月共加班22小时，都已在考勤系统审批通过（截图附后），但9月工资条上的加班费是0。9月25日我向周经理反映过，他建议我找人事；9月28日我发邮件给何专员，目前还没有回复，我也已经跟她说了会联系您。麻烦您在10月12日（周一）前帮我确认这笔加班费是否漏算，以及哪天可以补发。谢谢您！
note: 工资类升级只写小时数、审批记录和已经找过谁；加班费怎么算以劳动合同和公司制度为准，第一封里先不提仲裁。

situation: I'm a customer success manager. Since Sept 21, appointment reminders for our client Brightline Dental have been failing to send, about 30 patients a day (ticket ENG-4412); the assigned engineer, Sam, has it in the backlog behind the Oct 20 release. Their ops lead, Nora, says they'll start looking at other vendors if it isn't fixed by Oct 15, and they renew on Oct 31 at $48k a year. I told Sam yesterday I'm taking it to his manager, Rita, and I need her answer by Friday Oct 2 so I can give Nora a date.
reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Fri Oct 2: priority for ENG-4412 (Brightline Dental)

Hi Rita, since Sept 21 Brightline Dental's appointment reminders have been failing to send, about 30 patients a day (ENG-4412). It's in Sam's backlog behind the Oct 20 release, and I've told him I'm raising the priority with you. Their ops lead, Nora, says they'll start looking at other vendors if it isn't fixed by Oct 15, and they renew on Oct 31 at $48k a year. Could you decide by Friday whether ENG-4412 moves ahead of the release work? I'd recommend yes, so I can give Nora a fix date.
note: Internal escalation on a customer's behalf: the email is about a priority call Rita owns, not about Sam, and says Sam already knows.

situation: I'm Ellen Hale. My mum, Margaret Hale (hospital number 448210), was told on Aug 20 she'd get a cardiology appointment within six weeks. I called the booking office on Sept 8 and Sept 22 and both times was told the referral is 'on the system' but there's no date. Her chest pains are getting more frequent and her GP said on Monday she needs to be seen soon. I'm emailing the hospital's patient liaison team.
reply:
Subject: Cardiology appointment needed by 2 Oct: referral from 20 August, no date yet
Dear Patient Liaison team, I'm writing about my mother, Margaret Hale, hospital number 448210. On 20 August she was told she'd get a cardiology appointment within six weeks. I called the booking office on 8 and 22 September and both times was told the referral is on the system, with no date. Her chest pains are getting more frequent, and her GP said on Monday that she needs to be seen soon. Could you confirm an appointment date, or who is handling the referral, by Friday 2 October? Thank you, Ellen Hale
note: If her chest pain worsens or comes on at rest, call emergency services now; this email is for the waiting list, not an emergency.

situation: I'm the only data analyst on our team. Two directors both need a big piece of work from me by Friday Oct 9: Priya wants the churn analysis for the board deck, Owen wants the pricing model for the Hartley renewal. Each is about 3 days of work, so I can only finish one. I've told both of them I'm taking it to our manager Dana to decide.
reply: Hi Dana, I need a priority call from you by tomorrow noon. Priya needs the churn analysis for the board deck and Owen needs the pricing model for the Hartley renewal, both by Friday Oct 9, and each is about 3 days of work, so I can finish one. I've told them both I'm bringing it to you. Could you decide which comes first? My recommendation is the Hartley model, since the renewal date can't move, and I can give Priya a one-page churn summary for the board deck instead.
note: When two people with equal power disagree, escalate the choice, not the people, and tell both before you do.
